```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended (1).db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

## Task 1
```{r}
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings")

listings_with_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

hosts_10_plus = listings_with_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(host_listings >= 10) |>
  dplyr::distinct(host_id)

A1 = nrow(hosts_10_plus)

chicago_total = listings_with_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  nrow()

chicago_10_plus = listings_with_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago", host_listings >= 10) |>
  nrow()

A2 = 100 * chicago_10_plus / chicago_total

A1
A2
```

## Task 2 
```{r}
family_listings = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    price_per_person = price / accommodates
  )

neighbourhood_summary = family_listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price_per_person = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(n >= 20)

columbus_neighbourhoods = neighbourhood_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_price_per_person)

A3 = columbus_neighbourhoods |>
  dplyr::slice(1) |>
  dplyr::pull(neighbourhood)

A3
```

## Task 3
```{r}
city_room_summary = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

A4 = city_room_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt"
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(estimated_revenue_l365d)

A4
```

## Task 4 
```{r}
revenue_ranked = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

columbus_revenue = revenue_ranked |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    top_10_revenue = sum(
      estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    total_revenue = sum(
      estimated_revenue_l365d,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

A5 = 100 * columbus_revenue$top_10_revenue /
  columbus_revenue$total_revenue

A5
```

## Task 5
```{r}
entire_homes = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt")

october_availability = availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

mostly_taken = entire_homes |>
  dplyr::inner_join(october_availability, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month
  )

city_shares = mostly_taken |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    share_mostly_taken = mean(mostly_taken, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(share_mostly_taken)

A6 = city_shares |>
  dplyr::slice(1) |>
  dplyr::pull(city)

A7 = city_shares |>
  dplyr::slice(1) |>
  dplyr::pull(share_mostly_taken)

A6
A7
```

## Task 6
```{r}
reviews_with_city = reviews |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |>
      dplyr::select(id, city),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    month >= "2025-07",
    month <= "2026-06"
  )

monthly_reviews = reviews_with_city |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

twin_cities_reviews = monthly_reviews |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))

A8 = twin_cities_reviews |>
  dplyr::slice(1) |>
  dplyr::pull(month)

A9 = twin_cities_reviews |>
  dplyr::slice(1) |>
  dplyr::pull(total_reviews) /
  twin_cities_reviews |>
  dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  dplyr::pull(total_reviews)

A8
A9
```

## Task 7
```{r}
superhost_summary = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    superhost_status = dplyr::if_else(
      host_is_superhost == "t",
      "Superhost",
      "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, superhost_status) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

B1 = superhost_summary |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    premium = median_price[superhost_status == "Superhost"] -
      median_price[superhost_status == "Other"]
  )

B1
```

## B2
```{r}
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings")

concentration = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id") |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    A2_share = 100 * sum(host_listings >= 10) / dplyr::n(),
    A5_share = 100 * sum(
      estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / sum(
      estimated_revenue_l365d,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

concentration
```
